audit.whatIsWrong: Three layers disagreed about who wins the back half of the lane: packet.levelChart gives Taliyah five rows, content win[] gives her five, full phases[].side gives her four and 'Skill' for rows 4-6 — against a 53.37% Azir win rate over 208 games. packet.defects flags exactly this.
audit.why: Weaver's Wall is 180/150/120s and is a travel wall, not a lane-kill spike (content whys[4] already says so), while Azir's level 6 adds a knockback wall and dive insurance. From level 6 onward the lane belongs to Azir, which is what the win rate shows.
audit.corrected: full phases[4/5/6].side -> Azir with all three whys rewritten, and the matching content win[4] -> Azir with whys[4] rewritten in the same proposal. Content win[5] and win[6] were already Azir, so the pairs now agree on every row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 row treated Weaver's Wall as a lane threat and gave the stage to Taliyah or to 'Skill'; and whys[3] claimed her pressure persists 'right up through level 6', which now contradicts the corrected row.
audit.why: Enemy kit R: 'Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it', 180/150/120s, 2500/4500/6500 range — a map-pressure and roam spike. Her real lane spike is Threaded Volley falling to 4s and 3s.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now names the Threaded Volley cooldown drop as her peak; whys[4] and phases[4].why hand level 6 to Azir on the 180s Weaver's Wall vs Emperor's Divide comparison.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction in this matchup was never stated anywhere on the page: Unraveled Earth stuns anything that DASHES through it, and Azir's Shifting Sands is a dash. Seismic Shove also knocks you through the same minefield for the stun. packet.defects also flags that the page never names Threaded Volley, Unraveled Earth or Weaver's Wall.
audit.why: Enemy kit E: 'Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them', flat 14s, 950 range, 90 mana. Owner kit E Shifting Sands is a dash, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t and loading now all state that dashing across Unraveled Earth stuns you, with the 14s and 22s numbers attached; the other three ability names now appear on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — only 'matchup-defining' and 'count it out loud'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Seismic Shove 14s (free at rank 5), Unraveled Earth flat 14s, Threaded Volley down to 3s; report[9].t and dosFull bullets key the commit window to the 14s shove.

audit.whatIsWrong: Taliyah is female and the page said 'his last-hit', 'he cannot answer', 'the wave he has to stand in', 'on his last-hits'. dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted verbatim, neither answering its title. dontsFull[1].d quoted nineteen seconds for Shifting Sands; rank 1 is 22s.
audit.why: champ-gender lists taliyah as female. Defect catalogue items 1, 2 and 6.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every rewritten field including both dosFull titles; bled bullets replaced; Shifting Sands quoted at 22s.

notes: Kit-flag conflict, reported per instructions: Taliyah's Q and W carry derived flags 'grounding' and (on Q) 'hardCC', but Riot's own descriptions for Threaded Volley and Seismic Shove mention neither. I trusted the descriptions and asserted nothing about grounding or a Q stun anywhere. The stun I did write comes from the E text itself ('If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them'). Level chart: packet, content and full all disagreed; I moved rows 4-6 to Azir in both layers because a 53.37% win rate with a 180s travel-wall ultimate on the enemy will not support Taliyah owning five of seven stages, and packet.defects flags the same contradiction. That is a Medium-confidence judgement on row 4 specifically — rows 5 and 6 were already Azir in the content layer. phases[].rating left untouched (all 7/10 and 6/10, no scale I can ground). Weaver's Wall vs Emperor's Divide: I did NOT claim the knockback interrupts her wall-surf, because neither kit text supports it.
